in_marathi.name: Shatakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shatakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge and power. She is also known as the goddess of eyes and the one who has a thousand eyes. She is the deity of the sun and the destroyer of darkness.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Wisdom and Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shatakshi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge and power. She is also known as the goddess of eyes and the one who has a thousand eyes. She is the deity of the sun and the destroyer of darkness.
